Functional port and Xe adaptation

serve/replicas.py derives the upstream bounded Router/ReplicaEngine interface and request routing from load plus hashed 64-token conversation blocks. The native engine still checks actual prefixes. Numeric replicas divides gpu_pci plus split_pci into equal groups; explicit entries use devices PCI lists, not CUDA/HIP GPU indices. PCI addresses are canonical lowercase domain:bus:device.function values; domainless forms receive 0000. Duplicate aliases, duplicate devices within/across groups, empty explicit groups, malformed addresses, nonpositive/bool counts and more than 16 groups are refused. replicas absent/false or numeric1 leaves the existing single-engine route unchanged. Configs retain the existing native batch arguments and restrictions. Each child receives its exact STRATA_GPU_PCI; multi-card groups alone receive the existing engine_args layer-split/--split-device route. Explicit raw device/group overrides are refused. Optional per-entry env and args are supported, but cannot replace shared model paths or device ownership; native flags and format/math remain the engine's existing implementation.

Each replica has a distinct log, learned-profile output and conversation persistence path (including common raw argument paths). Each child keeps its own native KV/session/cache/nonfinite/READY state. The replica front intentionally hides ambiguous single-file session SAVE/RESTORE and dynamic VRAM/control operations, as upstream does; it does not weaken the existing single-engine session safeguards. Settings and HTTP routes use the existing Service, including sampling validation, context checks, nonfinite retry/error behavior and cancellation. Total serving concurrency is the sum of per-child slots, with an unbatched engine counting one. Health exposes per-replica alive/running/routed state while preserving the existing service/loaded fields; /metrics exposes the same states and aggregate INFO memory/cache facts.

The actual native backend selection source src/core/device.cpp was read. STRATA_GPU_PCI must match exactly one usable SYCL device's PCI address; native backend/type/capability selection remains authoritative. No CUDA/HIP inference path or C++/CMake source was changed. Common provider filters/library settings remain common; a filter hiding a selected card produces native startup failure, not a substituted device. Main must verify actual PCI and executable/provider identity for every selected group before real admission.

CPU affinity

serve/cpu_affinity.py ports physical-package/core grouping with whole permitted SMT sibling sets, constrained to the server's inherited allowed CPU mask. Reserved cores are removed as whole physical cores. Unknown/negative topology, invalid CPU IDs, empty masks or insufficient cores are errors; explicit replica_cpus:false disables partitioning. Default no-replica launches retain the original [exe,--serve,args] command.

Threaded-server preexec_fn was not copied. The server starts its own sys.executable with -I and the absolute cpu_affinity.py path. This independent child validates its inherited mask, calls sched_setaffinity(0,mask), then execv on the exact absolute configured executable with the same PID and configured environment/stdio. The threaded server, foreign processes and their affinities are never changed. The parent Popen remains the owned process across exec. StrataEngine.spawn still describes the original engine command; restart retains the selected cpus separately. Qualification must therefore bind the interpreter, helper source, configured launcher and real ELF target (where the Xe executable is a shell launcher), plus inherited CPU mask. No actual exec/path/affinity qualification was performed here.

Resource admission and ownership

Replica startup requires explicit positive replica_ram_mib per-engine peak reservation and replica_vram_mib free-VRAM floor per selected GPU. RAM must cover a conservative deduplicated native/pack/MTP model-file floor (scan limited to4096 files), and an explicit resident-budget-gib cannot exceed the reservation. This is deliberately conservative for mmap/tiered configurations; it is not an estimate of measured peak RSS. Initial free RAM must cover N reservations plus6144 MiB system reserve. Reload/heal admission requires one pending reservation plus that reserve after reaping the old child. Host MemAvailable is intersected with all visible v1/v2 memory-cgroup ancestor limit-minus-current readings. Conventional full filesystem roots are verified using bounded mountinfo; hidden/bind-mounted subtree layouts and missing/invalid counters fail closed. A true unlimited cgroup2 root with no memory.max is accepted only with mount-root proof. Every selected PCI device must exist and have a known free-VRAM reading meeting the explicit floor. Missing GPU/RAM observations are errors. Native allocation/admission remains authoritative; the reservation does not install a new hard RSS cap or change native memory limits. Administrators must review peak KV, cache, session and vision demand, concurrent services, explicit native caps and the conservative source floor before enabling replicas.

Initial startup is serial and all-or-nothing. Lazy children are retained as owners before attempting restart/READY, so a partial failure visits every created owner with existing close. Post-READY arena_mib must be known, nonnegative and no larger than the reservation. Lazy reload and healing repeat capacity and post-READY checks. Existing close/restart handles normal QUIT, bounded existing termination escalation and reap; this port creates no foreign kill/reset/unbind/service mechanism. A failed close is printed/preserved, never described as successful admission; Main must supervise/report any EngineStuck failure under its existing bounded owner. This app port does not replace that outer supervisor.

Live routing/recovery bookkeeping uses separate locks from native per-slot controls. Healing is cooldown-limited, serialized through a lifecycle lock and held as owned thread objects. Close prevents new routes/heals, joins owned recovery threads, then closes every child. Unload serializes with healing. A serving replica can continue while another fails admission/restart. Process-generation changes and nonfinite invalidate only that replica's prefix hints. A request waiting for an unbatched child polls cancel and emits normal keepalives; cancel before dispatch starts no generation. Actual child generators are closed/STOP-drained before releasing the replica turn. Only completed, uncancelled outputs are added to hints; partial output/error/nonfinite is not recached. Per-request DONE dictionaries are snapshotted before unlock, preventing a later request from overwriting accounting read by Service.

Monitor/telemetry and setup

Existing Monitor is retained. Each replica uses its own ConvCacheLog lock/current-run cursor and bounded reader; metrics aggregates numeric occupancy only when every term is known and returns each replica's cache view. Availability/completeness are all-child conjunctions; no fabricated aggregate last event is chosen. Existing requests/reuse totals remain Service totals. Telemetry optionally samples all selected PCI cards. Any observed positive aggregate reading vetoes the child's stall check; zeros, absent/error/stale readings retain Main's unknown/fail-open policy. No GPU-active process is killed based on missing display metrics.

Setup gains --replicas, --replica-ram-mib, --replica-vram-mib, config retention and structural/group availability validation. Selected setup GPU indices are converted using the existing GPU inventory into saved PCI lists. Single-card overrides conflict with active replicas; --replicas1 returns to the existing single-engine route. Default start-call keyword sets remain unchanged. Native --bench/calibrate are explicitly single-engine tools and refuse active replica configs, rather than silently testing one unrelated layer split. Existing HTTP warmup goes through the actual server/replica lifecycle. Japanese MULTIGPU additions precede matching English additions, with no measured throughput claim.

Source-only fixture coverage

serve/test_replicas.py adapts official config/router/load/affinity/nonfinite and actual fake-engine HTTP tests to explicit PCI groups and this tree's free test_chat_template.jinja. It supplies a fake telemetry object before serve(), so CPU tests do not create a real GPU sampler. The existing fake Python engine is the only child executable. Fixtures include independent engines with/without native slots, native protocol output equality, routing/reuse, dead-replica avoidance, metrics and health. Cleanup targets only test-owned temporary files/children when Main runs them.
serve/test_cpu_affinity.py covers synthetic physical siblings, reserved whole cores, partial allowed masks, missing topology/insufficient cores, invalid masks/relative executable refusal, unchanged default argv and the isolated child-only wrapper. Its one real CPU subprocess fixture uses Python only, a10-second timeout and the current permitted mask; it verifies the parent mask is unchanged.
serve/test_replica_admission.py uses private tiny files and synthetic proc/cgroup trees for v1/v2/ancestor/root/missing-layout cases, missing reservations, RAM/VRAM refusal, partial READY failure closing all created fake owners, actual generator close-before-unlock, no partial hint recache, DONE snapshot stability and shutdown blocking new routes. No model/driver is constructed. tools/test_setup_replicas.py covers unchanged defaults, explicit PCI/count/reservation config and overlap/incomplete admission. All four files are SOURCE, not executed results.

Then the affected full serve/setup regression suite, especially parallel/queue cancellation/restart waiters/READY timeout/nonfinite/context overflow/Monitor/telemetry/session save and setup config-retention/start selection tests. Run all mandatory Python/docs/all-file lints and REUSE, fixing newly introduced findings only; none was run here. Review exact CPU wrapper interpreter/helper/launcher/ELF and device/env/library identities, real allowed mask and sysfs topology. Review actual cgroup mount layout and resource reservation sizes; unsupported layouts intentionally remain errors. Review typed engine error/503 behavior under lazy all-child READY failure and per-child admission failure, recovery shutdown joining and EngineStuck ownership. Only after CPU/source qualification may Main do a finite, explicitly owned multi-GPU health/startup/QUIT admission with independent groups and complete fresh provider/fault gates. Model quality/throughput, partial GPU-loss and high-load replicas need separate bounded Main qualification; there are no results here.

Status

SourceOnly/unverified. No tests, lints, formatter, AST, target imports, builds, GPU/model/profiler/process/service operations, Git commands or cleanup were executed. Only permitted source/report text was written, and source hashes were computed. No new inference setting, default GPU group, worker count, math/kernel policy, model or global affinity was imposed. Existing Windows keepawake/Job Objects and CUDA/HIP-specific replica selection are outside this Linux SYCL port. Original result/receipt status was not changed. Main exclusively owns remaining execution, review, Git commit/push and evidence retention.
